answer: Work slots are scarce: claiming one burns a 50 POA deposit that is never refunded, like a toll to cross a ridge into the market. The delta between one honest identity and 100 fakes is pure cost: 100 slots burn 5,000 POA against 30 POA per epoch, so payback takes 167 epochs. Honest agents pass a jade seal check — one verified work history tied to the slot — pay once and keep their full share; a bought slot fails the seal and its burn is lost.
